title: Partner representation audit for allelic heterogeneity
description: Code and derived evidence for technical scoreability, phenotype-balanced coverage and incremental phenotype information in partner-aware protein representations. This independently versioned project archive reuses the scientific payload of the preceding partner-representation-audit archive without reanalysis; historical attribution and licences are preserved. Excludes pretrained weights, encoder caches, restricted raw databases, manuscripts and correspondence.
